name: DeepSeek-llama3.1-Bllossom-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A Korean-language SFT of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B (identical tensor set, 8.03B). Real trade, not a clean sweep: wins the Korean benchmarks by a lot - MATH500_ko 78.07 vs 63.40, AIME24_ko 36.67 vs 25.56 - and LOSES the same tests in English, AIME24_en 40.00 vs 46.67 and MATH500_en 87.80 vs 88.87. Both loss rows are recorded. Eval is the author's own: fp16, max_tokens 32786, temp 0.7, mean of 3 runs, Korean columns from a high-quality translation of the original questions. Base is a ROW in one four-column table alongside the 70B siblings. Licence MIT (the weights are llama3.1-derived). Repo created 2025-02-13. Confidence 0.5.
